## User problem

Describe the deployment, tool catalog, and task that the current behavior cannot handle well.

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete before/after example and alternatives considered.

## Acceptance evidence

Explain how to verify the improvement and whether it affects prefix stability,
execution policy, session recovery, configuration, or runtime compatibility.
